div.span:
How one machine goes from an idea to a validated model, and how each review upgrades the pipeline.
Example used: the smelter family (rounds r4 and r5, then S3 validated).
Out of scope: game balance and recipes (progression rework, later).
v0.1 · source: docs/architecture/machine-pipeline
